title: Playing with Turk Murphy
summary: Garland enjoyed Turk Murphy and stayed until Murphy took a band to Hamburg.

blocks.x: Okay, that's great. But let's just try to finish up this session, Tootie, with tracing your career up to today, then. All right, so we're having a lovely time, we've spoken about some of the instruments, now, after you worked with Earl Hines, you worked for a bit with Turk Murphy.
Wonderful. I always liked to play with Turk, wonderful fella he was to me, anyhow.
It was a happy kind of music he played. How long did you work with Turk?
I would say quite a little while. Until he got ready to go to Hamburg. During the war, you know, he take a bunch over --
And I wants to stay at the Tin Angel, and --
-- you went to Germany then with the band?
I didn't go with them, no then I didn't go.
